# claude-code-statusline-picker

> Interactive status line picker for Claude Code: customize what the status line shows — toggle, reorder and live-preview components in a terminal UI, then save; the renderer picks the change up on its next refresh without restarting the session.

A working prototype demonstrating that a built-in `/statusline` picker is mostly
assembly-and-UI over data Claude Code already computes on every render. Node.js renderer
plus Python 3 picker; no dependencies, no build step, no network access. Linux and macOS
(the interactive picker needs a POSIX tty; on Windows use WSL). MIT licensed.

## Core

- [README](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker#readme): what it does and why, install, key bindings, exit codes, the configuration contract, and the payload fields observed on Claude Code 2.1.247
- [statusline.js](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/statusline.js): the self-describing renderer — the component registry lives here alone, and the picker discovers it with `node statusline.js --segments`
- [statusline_picker.py](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/statusline_picker.py): the interactive picker; `--show`, `--selftest` and `--payload FILE` also run without a TTY
- [commands/statusline.md](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/commands/statusline.md): a `/statusline` slash command that opens the picker in a tmux pane above a running Claude Code session and reads its exit code back through a sentinel file
- [statusline-config.example.json](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/statusline-config.example.json): an example of the five-rule configuration contract

## Evidence

- [lab/picker_lab.py](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/lab/picker_lab.py): pty regression lab — 28 cases driving the real picker binary under sandboxed HOME directories, with the observed-failing pre-fix log kept beside the post-fix log
- [lab/exit_contract_lab.py](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/lab/exit_contract_lab.py): pins that environmental failures exit 2 and are never relabelled as picker defects (exit 1)
- [lab/carrier_lab.py](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/lab/carrier_lab.py): eleven live tmux arms over the pane-and-sentinel handoff, extracted from the shipped slash command rather than retyped
- [lab/save_failure_probe.py](https://github.com/konsta95/claude-code-statusline-picker/blob/main/lab/save_failure_probe.py): proves a failed save writes nothing, measured against a genuinely unsavable directory
